events.title: Jacksonville Holiday River Fest & Light Boat Parade
events.blurb: The City of Jacksonville's riverfront holiday night: the city Christmas tree lighting at 6:15 p.m., the Light Boat Parade on the St. Johns River at 6:30 p.m., and fireworks around 8:30 p.m.
events.blurbEs: La noche festiva de la Ciudad de Jacksonville junto al río: encendido del árbol de Navidad de la ciudad a las 6:15 p.m., el Light Boat Parade por el río St. Johns a las 6:30 p.m. y fuegos artificiales alrededor de las 8:30 p.m.
events.getThere: Parking at Yates Garage (200 E Adams St) on the Northbank, or the DCPS Building (1701 Prudential Dr) and Kings Avenue Garage (1201 Kings Ave) on the Southbank; downtown meters are free on weekends. The Skyway does not run on weekends. Expect street closures downtown.

events.title: Jaguars vs. Titans
events.blurb: The Jaguars host division rival Tennessee in their Salute to Service game, honoring active-duty service members and veterans.
events.blurbEs: Los Jaguars reciben a su rival de división Tennessee en su partido Salute to Service, en honor a militares en servicio activo y veteranos.

events.title: Hallmark(ish): The Unofficial Parody Musical
events.blurb: A parody musical of holiday TV movies, following an overworked city executive who goes home to save Christmas. Doors open at 7 p.m.
events.blurbEs: Un musical de parodia de las películas navideñas de televisión, sobre una ejecutiva agobiada que vuelve a su pueblo para salvar la Navidad. Las puertas abren a las 7 p.m.

events.title: Deck the Chairs
events.blurb: Decorated lifeguard stands and holiday displays at the Jacksonville Beach oceanfront. The lights are on nightly from 5 p.m. to 1 a.m. through Jan 1.
events.blurbEs: Torres de salvavidas decoradas y adornos navideños frente al mar en Jacksonville Beach. Las luces se encienden cada noche de 5 p.m. a 1 a.m. hasta el 1 de enero.

events.title: Jacksonville Beach Christmas Market
events.blurb: A Sunday holiday market next to the Deck the Chairs displays, with free admission. It opens for the season this Sunday and returns each Sunday through Dec 27.
events.blurbEs: Un mercado navideño dominical junto a las decoraciones de Deck the Chairs, con entrada gratuita. Abre la temporada este domingo y vuelve cada domingo hasta el 27 de diciembre.

events.title: Riverside Arts Market
events.venue: Riverside Arts Market (under the Fuller Warren Bridge)
events.blurb: Jacksonville's weekly Saturday market under the Fuller Warren Bridge, with local art, crafts, jewelry, baked goods and produce vendors. Rain or shine.
events.blurbEs: El mercado semanal de los sábados en Jacksonville, bajo el puente Fuller Warren, con arte local, artesanías, joyería, panadería y productos frescos. Llueva o haga sol.

events.title: Christmas Carole
events.blurb: The Alhambra's holiday dinner-theater production, with a meal served before the show. It runs Nov 19 to Dec 24; check the box office for this weekend's performance times.
events.blurbEs: La producción navideña de cena-teatro del Alhambra, con comida servida antes de la función. Va del 19 de noviembre al 24 de diciembre; consulta la taquilla para los horarios de este fin de semana.

events.title: Home for the Holidays: Sheena Easton, All-4-One, Ruben Studdard & Lindsey Webster
events.blurb: Sheena Easton, All-4-One, Ruben Studdard and Lindsey Webster share the Florida Theatre stage for a night of holiday favorites and their own hits. Doors open at 6 pm.
events.blurbEs: Sheena Easton, All-4-One, Ruben Studdard y Lindsey Webster comparten el escenario del Florida Theatre en una noche de clásicos navideños y sus grandes éxitos. Las puertas abren a las 6 pm.

events.title: American Aquarium with special guest David Wimbish
events.addr: 1050 A1A North, Ponte Vedra Beach, FL 32082
events.blurb: Alt-country band American Aquarium plays Ponte Vedra Concert Hall with special guest David Wimbish. Doors open at 5:30 pm, with general admission standing and reserved seats.
events.blurbEs: La banda de country alternativo American Aquarium se presenta en Ponte Vedra Concert Hall con el invitado especial David Wimbish. Las puertas abren a las 5:30 pm y hay entrada general de pie y asientos reservados.
